description: This file defines the BordersRenderer class responsible for rendering borders in a document rendering context, including methods for drawing borders in various styles and orientations.

classes.name: BordersRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering borders with various styles, widths, and orientations in a document.

methods.name: BordersRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with border settings and graphics context.

methods.name: GetBorder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific border based on border type.

methods.name: GetColor
methods.description: Determines the color of a border based on its type and settings.

methods.name: GetStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style of a border based on its type.

methods.name: GetWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a border based on its type and settings.

methods.name: RenderVertically
methods.description: Renders a border vertically at specified position and height.

methods.name: RenderHorizontally
methods.description: Renders a border horizontally at specified position and width.

methods.name: RenderDiagonally
methods.description: Renders a diagonal border within specified rectangle.

methods.name: RenderRounded
methods.description: Renders a rounded corner border arc.

methods.name: GetPen
methods.description: Creates and returns a pen object for drawing borders with specified style.

methods.name: IsRendered
methods.description: Checks if a specific border type is set to be rendered.
